script.base: Spread and total were not saved, so this is a tendency script only, not the book's expected leader or point total. IND has been a Taylor game on the ground (66 carries, 258 yards, 22.0 per game at 3.91 YPC) with Downs the pass leader (24 targets, 186 yards, 281 air yards). WAS blitzes 47%, and that is the IND QB's less-bad state (EPA/dropback -0.03 on 32 blitz dropbacks vs -0.20 with no blitz), so the base flow is Taylor carries plus blitz checkdowns to his screen role (11 targets, 67 yards, -14 air yards), not a clean deep script. WAS can stay balanced against an IND defense that blitzes only 23% and allows 5.08 YPC, because WAS QB EPA is +0.17 with no blitz vs -0.04 when blitzed, with Croskey-Merritt the lead runner (47 carries, 142 yards) inside a committee.
script.flip1: IND gets ahead and stays on the ground: Taylor's carries climb past 22.0 per game, WAS has to throw (Diggs and McLaurin already at 22 targets each), and Taylor's receiving chances shrink if WAS cannot keep blitzing. That flip would cash a Taylor rush over and can stall his rec-yards line.
script.flip2: WAS gets ahead, IND abandons the run, and Taylor's 66-carry role dies while Downs (8.0 targets/g, 11.7 aDOT) and Warren (7.3 targets/g) absorb throws. Croskey-Merritt's 15.7 carries at 3.02 YPC would miss a 61 rush line in that script; Taylor checkdowns can still show up if the 47% blitz travels with a WAS lead.

data_check.notes: No model, sim median, or Pinnacle no-vig is in the pack, so the test is L3 production versus the listed line. Taylor 67 rec yards over 3 games is 22.3 per game versus 19.5, and the 47% WAS blitz plus the IND QB EPA split agrees with the checkdown read. Croskey-Merritt rush over 61 was the other brainstorm (IND allows 5.08 YPC and 10 runs of 10+) and was dropped as a lean because his own 3.02 YPC and 47.3 yards per game contradict it. Downs over 72, Warren under 58.5, and Diggs over 57.5 were not carded: recent yards sit on the wrong side of those lines or the location/blitz splits cut the side.

A snap cap or inactive would do the same and cannot be checked in this pack. That counter is why this is a lean, not a strong; 11 targets is still a role, so the counter does not outweigh the read.
